title: Karbala Mein Chelum Hai Noujawan Akber Ka_
body:
Karbala mein chelum hai noujawan akber ka
<<MINI>>
Madare Ali akber padh rahi hain yeh nouha
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tum chale gaye beta maa ko choor kar tanha
Kya karo mein jee ke ab bolo aye mere beta
<<MINI>>
Madar e Ali akber padh rahi hai yeh nouha
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Phir ke Shaam o kofa mein dar ba dar barehna sar
Qaid e Shaam se chutt kar aayi hai teri madar
<<MINI>>
Madar e Ali akber padh rahi hai yeh nouha
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Naa tu ab Sakina hai aur na hai Ali Asghar
Karbala ke jungle mein lutt gaya mera sab ghar
<<MINI>>
Madar e Ali akber padh rahi hai yeh nouha
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Chand sa tera seena aur woh seena ka phal .
Rehta hai nighahoon ke saamne mere har pal
<<MINI>>
Madar e Ali akber padh rahi hai yeh nouha
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Peet thi hai sar apna kehke Zainab e muztar
Haaye aye Ali akber haaye aye Ali akber
<<MINI>>
Madar e Ali akber padh rahi hai yeh nouha
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jab chali mein karbal se beridah rasan basta
Jalti reet par laasha tha padha hova tera
<<MINI>>
Madar e Ali akber padh rahi hai yeh nouha
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Rootey rootey guzregi ab yeh zindagi
Tere saath mujhko bhi kaash mout aajati
<<MINI>>
Madar e Ali akber padh rahi hai yeh nouha
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Noujawaan bete ko khokey maamta kaise
Aye Hassan gazaaregi zindagi bhala kaise
<<MINI>>
Madar e Ali akber padh rahi hai yeh nouha
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz:- Hassan abedi
